criteria_version: Frozen review trial criteria v1 — T1–T5

reviewer.scope: Single semantic review of the frozen fictional baseline and its exact retained input. No production observations, implementation verification or external research.

timing.qualification: Clock observations bracket reading and semantic assessment, excluding artifact writing. Wall time is not human labor; active model effort and monetary usage were not observable.

severity_definition: High means a substantive factual or measurement error that must be corrected before this draft could pass semantic review. None means no correction recommended. This is not a production incident rating.

findings.material_error_category: False zero caused by treating parser output as observed evidence

evidence.short_basis: The fictional retained-answer description says one source link was present, while the illustrative parser returned an empty array.

findings.recommended_correction: Describe the expected-one/parsed-zero discrepancy as a fictional parser failure. Do not claim that the answer had zero citations or infer market visibility.
findings.false_alarm_uncertainty: Low: the cited evidence explicitly contradicts the zero-citation conclusion. Its described source link is fictional, not an independently inspected real answer.

findings.material_error_category: Unsupported measured comparison and causal attribution

evidence.short_basis: The values 68 and 74 are hand-authored without a scoring formula; a rewrite and index update coincide and cannot be separated.

findings.recommended_correction: Label both numbers as illustrative design values and remove the measured-readiness and rewrite-caused-improvement claims. A numerical difference alone does not establish improvement or causation.
findings.false_alarm_uncertainty: Low: the six-point arithmetic is valid, but the measurement and causal interpretations are expressly unsupported. Do not flag the arithmetic itself as erroneous.

findings.material_error_category: API-to-consumer equivalence and unsupported customer-observation claim

evidence.short_basis: The fictional API examples explicitly are not consumer ChatGPT observations.
The consumer capture failed before retaining any answer; consumer visibility is unknown, not zero.

findings.recommended_correction: Keep the API example separate and state that the failed fictional consumer capture establishes neither a recommendation nor what potential customers see in ChatGPT.
findings.false_alarm_uncertainty: Low: both cited records explicitly reject the conclusion. No inference about actual ChatGPT behavior is available.

findings.material_error_category: Invented company facts replacing explicit unknowns

evidence.short_basis: Both founding date and customer count are marked NEEDS VERIFICATION; neither 2018 nor 500 is supported.

findings.recommended_correction: Replace both asserted facts with explicit unknown/needs-verification statements; do not substitute guessed dates or counts.
findings.false_alarm_uncertainty: Low: two unsupported facts are present in one finding. This review counts the finding once, not as two corrected findings.

evidence.short_basis: The fictional page description begins with a slogan and lacks a self-contained category definition.

findings.recommended_correction: None. Preserve the recommendation, its explicit lack of established AI visibility benefit, and the statement that it is not permission to change the website.
findings.false_alarm_uncertainty: No error flagged. Improved comprehension remains a plausible content hypothesis, not a demonstrated result; the existing qualified wording preserves that distinction.

boundary_review.basis: The title block clearly says DRAFT, FICTIONAL EVALUATION ONLY and NOT MEASURED; the scope repeats that capture timestamps describe fiction.
boundary_review.correction: Preserve these labels. They do not cure contradictory substantive claims in F1–F4.

boundary_review.assessment: Preserve; material issues already assigned to F1, F3 and F4
boundary_review.basis: The exact input retains null locale/model and other unavailable fields; the report explicitly says search is not measured and consumer capture failed. No real model, locale or collection context can be inferred.
boundary_review.correction: Keep null metadata explicit as unknown wherever context is rendered. Preserve not-measured and failed states without turning either into zero.

boundary_review.basis: The scope correctly identifies fixture-only-report-review v1 and no defined score formula. F2 contradicts that limitation.
boundary_review.correction: Preserve the method limitation and remove the unsupported interpretation; do not add a new score formula or causal claim.

boundary_review.basis: The baseline explicitly denies client release/approval and requires monthly owner approval under DEC-006. F5 also denies website-change approval.
boundary_review.correction: Preserve the monthly scope. This review neither approves release nor establishes a different offer's release policy.

boundary_review.assessment: Baseline recorded; post-correction outcome not yet assessable
boundary_review.basis: Reviewed byte hashes identify the frozen source documents. No baseline, evidence or criteria were changed during this review.
boundary_review.correction: The coordinator should retain the exact evidence and F5, then compare the single corrected version against the baseline. Do not record T5 as passed before that comparison.

summary.new_errors_after_correction: Not assessable; correction has not occurred
summary.reviewer_false_alarms: Not independently adjudicated; confidence notes are not a measured false-alarm rate
summary.next_step: Coordinator may perform the authorized single correction pass and record its comparison. No iterative reviewer loop or ongoing adoption is authorized.
